notes.title: Update March 1, 2022
notes.content:
PATCH HIGHLIGHTS:
The update fixes important bugs.
Bugs not listed in the list have received feedback from players and will continue to be updated and fixed this week.

1. Bone Dragon: BUG that can be placed into the field from the cemetery without paying the cost.
2. Death Evil Shepherd: A bug where you can draw cards without paying COST.
3. Benobe: When the sacrifice summoned by the effect is dragged to its own troops in the round, the sacrifice cannot be sacrificed and cannot be moved.
4. Osai: BUG of sacrificing two sacrifices.
5. Email verification code when registering: Fixed a bug that may cause an abnormal error during registration.

notes.title: Dev Log 04 - Happy Lantern Festival, and then, the second test is coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the fourth installment of "Throne Development Log".
First of all, I wish you all a happy Lantern Festival! Happy Year of the Tiger!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/00bfe2ac3037cf8cf4b2af6e1a3c8d1f7e19d78f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/947d22998fdfe966df1011476421d0806af320a9.png[/img][/url]

From the last posting of the log is much closer, after all, in order to rush in the next week to open the service we have begun to work on the fifth day of Spring’s Festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/21481721085ba8a4ab038bd515ff0c6eb4acd162.png[/img]

[h2][b]The test of the bumpy, inevitable BUG[/b][/h2]
Book back to the topic. Before the Chinese New Year we "finally" released a new version as scheduled, this version includes a re-adjusted colorless technology system, movement/promotion rules, a large number of new cards, new battlefield, new special effects UI, new music sound effects and so on. It can be said that the version before the Chinese New Year is that we have moved all the content accumulated in the previous months in one go.

Of course, the essential thing is still "bugs", which we also received feedback. After returning from the holiday, first of all, we started to fix some bugs and made a small version of the update last week. Players who have already participated in the steam test should have experienced.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/f85ec49b3139696789b859cc5bef4d45179bf224.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/0588d6e9a39a42dd738ab1fd87437e38b09dbe42.png[/img][/url]

In addition to special effects optimization, rules adjustment, the most important thing is still hope that you can participate in the balance of the card test. The test added a lot of new cards, but also adjusted the old cards, there is the introduction of colorless technology. This write change is to hope that you can try some of the multi-color mixing ideas that could not be done before.

Of course, the current version is not a "Ultimate form".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/0fd85a5e990f1317eee1cc0af4a065ed820bced1.png[/img]

[h2][b]card major adjustment, the Lost Throne 3.0 [/b][/h2]
Just last Thursday, the designers had a collective meeting. In the sad report, we understand one thing: before the 23rd, the throne has to "rebirth".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/f1476c733e203af3c19e3bf34627f5744b7d789c.png[/img]

Yes, there are still two weeks left, but we are going to "rebirth" once again, the card table overhaul, into the throne 3.0 era. Of course, these changes are made because we want the 23rd version to be closer to the ideal balance.

And because of this until the 23rd will be immersed in bug fixes, hoping that by then the version will be more stable. So the 23rd before the probability is no version of the update, this point please forgive me.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/481a94015472be17d45191506a50a2c983470942.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/bd248580eaa9cd385fd19205640abd4632984acf.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]The application is to hurry up and test next week.[/b][/h2]
Finally, the matter of next week's test. The test is planned to open at noon on February 23, players who using Android can directly download the Throne in the TAPTAP. PC version will be also opened on the same day on Steam. Playtest application on steam has been opened, if you want to play the Lost Throne with PC, please follow the Lost Throne in the store page. After applying, you can open the game on the 23rd!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/258410629ddf053dbf6ac8311a60c800977fc7a2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Finally, repeat it again.
Android: pay attention to the TAPTAP, you can play as soon as it released.
PC: add the Lost Throne to the Steam Wishlist and participate in this playtest.[/b][/h3]

The game will release on February 23rd on both platforms!
We'll see you next week for the opening!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/22ce95d0d2831ad8508ce480c7a2ae4df215b898.png[/img]

notes.title: Development log 03 - The new version will be release next month
notes.content:
Hello players, here is the "Throne Development Journal" vol.3.
First of all, I'd like to take a knee!
After three months of silence, we're back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/4bbb2af0bb14087051008bfeccbfb07b59f72f6e.png[/img]

[h2]What did we do during the three months of disappearance[/h2]
The first thing to say is that both The Lost Throne and the developed us are still there. After October 15th, there was a 3-month long silent period. During this period a lot of things happened, but everything is still good. There were a lot of problems during this time, but we were still working on the release as we had planned. All in all, we made it through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/4d55de6895fcea010cd8eff3cf26f8f2a2c5be8f.png[/img]

The first is the adjustment of the combat logic. This part was discussed in October, and a lot of paper testing was done. Since it's been a bit long, here's a little more clarification. The adjustment of the combat logic is not a redesign of the combat part of the game. Rather, it is an optimization of the existing basis, organizing the logic of each stage, especially the logical sequence of the combat section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/109b47f1cc86620b95e3c3fc7d7ca024b7c71ca7.png[/img]

It was planned that a preliminary version would be given around November, but it was better to merge this part into the current version before meeting everyone. The reason is that during this time, the game's battlefield layout has been redesigned and new battlefield scenes have been created. And then with the new battlefield to do additional special effects and BGM. In short, we have left the completion of the battle logic adjustment until now, in order to give you a new battle feeling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/bfb192c2f5b6878f1a59155e15b367040b5e75be.png[/img]

More about this part will be disclosed later. In addition to these optimizations and adjustments, some of the cards that were hidden during the previous tests will be released in this test. More importantly, a certain mechanic will be readjusted, and the details will be disclosed later. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/22ce95d0d2831ad8508ce480c7a2ae4df215b898.png[/img]

[h2]What's next: Test first![/h2]
We've already said what we've done in the meantime, so it's time to have some fun with those pies in the sky!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/32320e65eac75deb461920febe5be0a104dd0311.png[/img]

First of all, today we will update the steam version and conduct a small test.
That's right, today!
This version will have more bugs and is not very stable. So then the next few days will be grasping the time to repair the bugs, this we still rest assured. If you already have a steam version of the test qualification, you can go to the updated version. If you do not have the test qualification, but want to play, you can join QQ group: 909384372

[h2]The next thing is about the post-holiday test[/h2]
For the record, the test time after the Throne Festival is: February 23rd, 2022 <Wednesday>.
Test content: the general test content and today's version is basically similar, there will be steam and tap (Android) two kinds of clients. Of course, we will test before the bug modification!

[h2]Finally, it's about the plan for 2022[/h2]
The game is expected to be online in 2022, if possible expected before the end of Q3. The platform is not decided for the time being, the initial plan is the steam version first. The global mobile version is planned to be optimized and adjusted after the steam version is stabilized, and the mobile version in China is not determined yet because of some well-known reasons.

Okay! 
That's all for now!

notes.title: 王座开发日志01-废墟重建
notes.content:
各位牌手大家好，这里是“王座开发日志”第一期。
[h3][b]这一期我们称之为“废墟重建”。[/b][/h3]

为什么要这么说？对王座熟悉的牌手都知道，这是一款开发了1年多游戏。这期间经历很多，能到这次安卓版本测试实属不易。就在这次测试前几周，整个开发团队经历了数个“通宵的长夜”和“无休的周末”。才终于迎来了“暴风骤雨”的测试。

但非常恐怖的是：BUG~实~在~是~太~多~了！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/dd7136628de4b668b19d5c357de965ffdcd939c4.jpg[/img]
[i]对不起，别骂了[/i]

除了持续收集BUG和意见，策划团队也在逐个测试和验证，找到问题的根源所在。
但很快策划们就发现有些事儿不对劲儿。
[h3][b]事情远没有这么简单！[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/3177882b5226ce8f53d418876377423915d21c95.png[/img]
[i]太可怕了[/i]

BUG修复的过程应该像是在有问题的机械上查找问题所在，然后针对问题进行修理。大家一开始很天真，以为就是这么简单。但残酷的实时击碎了大家的梦想。
这不是简单：验证——修复——校验的流程。王座本次测试中很多出现的BUG是因为在一些底层架构上出了逻辑问题。
比如出现3个、4个甚至5个部队同时卷入一次战斗，且它们均有一个以上的效果时。其场面的混乱和复杂，并不是现在架构能承载的。必然会出现很多逻辑问题。也就是大家在测试中出现各种奇怪BUG的原因。

综上所述，现在王座需要的是：[b][h3]对战斗架构的彻底修复[/h3][/b]！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/c613f33f35cd6c010cd26bc87b2a3605b93d330e.jpg[/img]
[i]拳头硬了！[/i]

所以，接下的工作首先就是整个策划团队冷静的坐下来、展开白板、重新对战斗架构进行掰开揉碎的梳理和重构。
睡觉？大概是扯淡呢！
废墟重建行动！启动！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/68533d89f512dd53b891cb502096c7a09ca07e34.jpg[/img]
[i]深夜的办公室[/i]

其中最重要的就是关于攻击过程中的逻辑流程，也就是前面提到的：多个部队同时卷入一次攻击，且拥有着各种效果时如何处理结算。对于这部分逻辑中，效果结算逻辑的梳理至少经过了以下几个阶段，从堆叠逻辑到直觉逻辑，从直觉逻辑再不断变形，最后再回到堆叠逻辑等等等等。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/b720f580c1e31f67171f34871789707709ae918c.jpg[/img]
[i]完全没搞懂[/i]

最后的最后，在各种权衡、说服、头脑风暴和武力压制后。大家终于统一了想法。最终决定了王座的攻击流程。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/d55600ff69ecabe913c401fbdd8e7c142bb819f9.jpg[/img]
[i]说详细点儿[/i]

战斗逻辑说明：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/fa8ceaaf516ff9d9767263ab565f37448e6a7804.jpg[/img]


好了！“王座开发日志”第一期在疯狂地逻辑风暴中结束了。接下来我们还会不定期更新。
咱们下期再见！ヾ(￣▽￣)Bye~Bye~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251682/05ee299999cfd18cd93cd1c4c73881e2bd02d056.jpg[/img]
[i]我先一步回英灵殿了[/i]

【补充一下】
想参加STEAM测试的人请填写在线文档“失落的王座Steam内测报名”。
我们会收集问卷，并向部分玩家发放测试key。
[h3]测试群QQ：524311609[/h3]

以下是问卷的二维码：
